overall_goal: Unpack groceries and organize the kitchen

goals.description: Store leafy greens and vegetables in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge and places bags of spring greens, kale, and other vegetables into the bottom drawers.

goals.description: Store mushrooms, burgers, and cauliflower in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person continues unpacking groceries, placing mushrooms, spring onions, veggie burgers, and cauliflower into the fridge shelves and drawers.

goals.description: Store salad, dairy, and fruits in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person places salad, mozzarella, cream, and grapes into the fridge, sets potatoes aside, and closes the fridge door.

goals.description: Store fruits and vegetables on the plastic stand
goals.rationale: The person transfers bananas, mandarins, garlic, kiwis, pears, and squash from the shopping bags to a plastic storage stand.

goals.description: Store pasta and pantry items in the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person places spaghetti, pasta, and lentils onto the top shelf of a cupboard.

goals.description: Store food waste bags under the sink
goals.rationale: The person takes paper food waste bags from the shopping bag and places them in the cupboard under the sink.

goals.description: Store canned and bottled goods in the bottom drawer
goals.rationale: The person places coconut milk, tomato puree, and bottles of tomato sauce into a large bottom drawer.

goals.description: Fold and store empty shopping bags
goals.rationale: The person flattens and folds the empty shopping bags, then stores them inside another bag in the cupboard under the staircase.

goals.description: Store shoes in the shoe cabinet
goals.rationale: The person picks up a pair of shoes from the floor and places them neatly into the shoe cabinet.
The person puts a box of yeast into a kitchen cupboard and stores superglue in a tool box under the staircase.

goals.description: Prepare the dishwasher for dirty dishes
goals.rationale: The person stacks dirty dishes on the counter, opens the dishwasher, and pulls out the bottom rack.
